data.description: Notification-only change identity observed through the shared storage adapter. The SQLite implementation retains its monotonic project revision and existing numeric protocol fields. The backend-neutral cursor is opaque and compared for equality, permitting future Git content identities to detect checkout/revert as well as edits. Mutations use resource versions/design readTokens, never a project cursor as write authority. Publish only committed material changes; refresh preserves user drafts.
data.name: Project Revision Marker
